about: The postcommunio of the formulary “Saint Stephen, the First Martyr” in the 1962 Roman Missal.

seg.tr: May the sacrament we have received aid us, O Lord; and by the intercession of blessed Stephen, Your Martyr, may it sustain us under Your everlasting protection. Through our Lord Jesus Christ, Thy Son, who liveth and reigneth with Thee in the unity of the Holy Ghost, God, world without end. Amen.
